invariants.rationale: Method calls like file.extension() and usesAtlas(file) require file not to be null.
file.extension() is called and the result is used, so it cannot be null without causing a NullPointerException.
If the extension is not tmx or tmj, an exception is thrown, so only these extensions reach method exit.
If parameter is null, it is replaced with a new BaseTiledMapLoader.Parameters, guaranteeing non-nullness after the first statement.
manager is passed to library loaders and assumed required for asset management, so null is unlikely to be allowed.
